objects.name: Lever bank (four levers)
objects.description: Four wall levers on floor 20 at columns 28, 30, 38 and 40, drawn as sprites (not map tiles). Each pull toggles one lever. The combination left down, three right up opens the lever door at column 26 (object record 1, target [0,1,1,1], 7:0x3609-0x3B73). Wrong combination closes it again.

refs.caption: map M41: floor 20, lever columns 28-40 (levers are sprites, not in the map)

objects.name: Lever-operated cave door
objects.description: Sliding door, 5 rows tall, opened by a lever combination (object table records 1, 3 and 4, 12-frame animation). Record 1 at column 26 on floor 20 (start area); records 3 and 4 at columns 130 and 125 on floor 21, each with one lever (columns 132 and 123). Closed doors push the hero back (3:0x5F25). Drawn as sprites.

refs.caption: map M41: door spot at column 26, floor 20
map M41: lever doors at columns 125 and 130, floor 21

objects.name: Rod pickup
objects.description: Item record 1 (TYC) at engine (21, 22), cell column 27 on floor 28. Used at the lift lock it is consumed.

refs.caption: map M41: floor 28, rod at column 27 (item drawn as sprite)

objects.name: Lift mechanism safety lock
objects.description: Mechanical safety lock of lift 1 at columns 34-36 on floor 55 (hero engine x 28-30, y 49). Using the rod plays XTYC.anm (TYCI JSI PREPNUL MECHANICKOU POJISTKU) and rewrites lift 1 from one stop (55) to three stops (29, 44, 55) (5:0xECB7). Here lift 1 is two lifts side by side, cols 49-51 (floors 44-55) and cols 52-54 (floors 29-44), both unlocked by the rod (flag:liftLock).

refs.caption: map M41: floor 55, lock spot columns 34-36 and lift 1 at columns 49-51

objects.name: Lift platform and shaft
objects.description: Six rope lifts: a thin chain or rope column at the lift centre (tile (10,36) on each stop's stand row) and a deck drawn by tiles (7,61) (7,62) (7,63) where the lift stops in a gap of an upper floor. Same slot code as level 1 (ds:0x4C90). Lift 1 is locked until the rod is used; lift 4 snaps to its top stop while the hero is on the cart stretch (7:0x87A5). Every lift here has two stops: the three-stop lifts 1 (floors 29, 44, 55) and 4 (floors 21, 23, 29) are each two lifts side by side that both reach the middle floor (lift 1: cols 49-51 and 52-54; lift 4: cols 82-84 for floors 23-29 and cols 86-88 for floors 21-23, the half the snap moves).

refs.caption: map M41: lift 2 shaft, columns 44-46, floors 20 to 44
map M41: lift 4 shaft, three stops 21, 23, 29

objects.name: Stalactite
objects.description: Rock stalactite hanging at columns 62-63, rows 16-18, over the chasm east of floor 20. Shot with the gun from floor 20 (hero engine x 50-55, y 14): krapnik1.anm, SESTRELIL JSI KRAPNIK, map switches to M42 (5:0x7294). In M42 the tiles are gone.

refs.caption: map M41: stalactite hanging
map M42: stalactite gone

objects.name: Crystal block
objects.description: Crystal on floor 29 at columns 62-64, rows 27-28. A code wall (east wall table entry engine (56, 23)) blocks floor 29 there until the stalactite falls on it; then the entry moves to (200, 200) and M42 shows the crystal smashed.

refs.caption: map M41: crystal intact
map M42: crystal smashed

objects.name: Three key slots
objects.description: Slot panel on floor 37 at columns 57-59 (hero engine x 51-53, y 31). Using the yellow, orange or blue key consumes it (vkart1-3.anm, POUZIL JSI ... KLIC). With all three inserted the key doors (object record 2) open (3:0xEB14).

refs.caption: map M41: floor 37, slot spot columns 57-59

objects.name: Stone blocks
objects.description: Two stacked stone blocks at column 81, rows 23-24 (stone block table, 7:0x3236). Destroyed only by fists: 5 punches each, then the frame runs to 12 and the block stops blocking. Drawn as sprites.

refs.caption: map M41: block spot at column 81, floor 23

objects.name: Orange key-card pickup
objects.description: Item record 3 (ORANZOVY KLIC) at engine (66, 17), column 72 on floor 23, west of the stone blocks.

refs.caption: map M41: floor 23, key at column 72

objects.name: Chasm with middle platform
objects.description: Gap in floor 21 between columns 94 and 101 with a one-cell middle platform at column 99; the hero jumps to it. Falling in is game over (zone engine x 85-98, y 16). The drop east of floor 20 under the stalactite (columns 60-67, rows 21-23) is a second deadly chasm: propast.anm, then game over (3:0xEA79).

refs.caption: map M41: chasm 8 and middle platform at column 99
map M41: deadly drop east of floor 20

objects.name: Explosive tank
objects.description: Explosive barrel at columns 103-104, rows 19-20 on floor 21. It exists only in map M42; its tiles (7,64) (7,65) (7,77) (7,78) are wall tiles. Shot with the gun from the middle platform (hero engine x 92-93, y 15) it explodes (barelbum.anm, ZNICIL JSI BAREL S VYBUSNINOU) and M43 loads. Shooting from x 94-98 kills the hero (5:0x63ED-0x69B7).

refs.caption: map M42: tank on floor 21
map M43: tank gone

objects.name: Blue key pickup
objects.description: Item record 4 (MODRY KLIC) at engine (111, 15), column 117 on floor 21.

refs.caption: map M41: floor 21, key at column 117

objects.name: Moving mine carts
objects.description: Row of yellow-green carts on rows 38-39, columns 97-130 (sheet 2 tiles). Standing on tiles (2,2) (2,4) (2,6) carries the hero east about 5.5 px per tick (7:0x8875). Ledges above let him jump off toward the yellow key. Reaching columns 123-125 (engine x 117-119, y 31-35) plays zabvozik.anm and ends the game: the hero must jump off before.

refs.caption: map M41: cart strip, rows 38-39

objects.name: Yellow key pickup
objects.description: Item record 2 (ZLUTY KLIC) at engine (129, 25), column 135 on floor 31, reached by jumping up the ledges above the carts.

refs.caption: map M41: floor 31, key at column 135

objects.name: Key doors
objects.description: Door at column 55 on floor 44 (object record 2, engine (49, 38)), 5 rows tall. Opens when all three keys sit in the slots. Drawn as a sprite.

refs.caption: map M41: floor 44, door spot at column 55

objects.name: Lava pits
objects.description: Everything below the bottom corridor (engine y above 68, floor row 75 and lower) is lava: lava.anm, then game over. Pits are the gaps in the corridor floor (columns 44, 46-49, 52, 55, 62, 64-65, 67-68, 75, 92 on row 74) and the left shaft (columns 12-15) whose ledge at row 75 is already in the lava band. Marker 13: from the west end of floor 63 the hero must reach the ledge at row 72 (columns 16-20, energy bonus) instead of falling down the shaft.

refs.caption: map M41: left shaft, ledge at row 75 and gap at columns 16-19
map M41: bottom corridor pits

objects.name: Entry card pickup
objects.description: Item record 5 (VSTUPNI KARTA) at engine (93, 46), column 99 on floor 52, at the top of a ledge stair. Pickup plays sebk44.anm (NALEZL JSI VSTUPNI KARTU).

refs.caption: map M41: card ledge, column 99 floor 52

objects.name: Card door
objects.description: Door at column 104 on floor 74 (object record 5, engine (98, 68)). Using the entry card at hero x 93-97 opens it (OTEVREL JSI DVERE); without it NEMAS U SEBE NIC CIM BY JSI OTEVREL DVERE. Drawn as a sprite.

refs.caption: map M41: floor 74, door spot at column 104

objects.name: Exit airlock
objects.description: Two doors on floor 48 at columns 133 and 141 (object records 6 and 7), open at start. Walking into columns 136-139 closes both; when the east door has closed level 5 starts (3:0xEB43-0xEBCF).

refs.caption: map M41: floor 48, airlock columns 133-141

objects.name: Stepping ledges
objects.description: Girder role (terrain girder). Free-standing rock ledge 2-3 cells wide and a third of a cell thick: the pebble floor strip with a ragged hanging underside, and a dark teal-green slab (#243024, #243030) about 1 cell wide lying on its left end. Ledges stand one row apart and 1-3 columns offset as zigzag stairs: cells 126-136 rows 16-31, 133-138 rows 21-29, 116-121 rows 31-38, 116-121 rows 48-55, 89-95 rows 52-58, 86-90 rows 60-65, 108-114 rows 60-64. They replace the ladders of other levels. State 1 has no slab. Sized w.

refs.caption: map M41: ledge stairs above the carts
map M41: ledges west of lift 5

objects.name: Chain or root column
objects.description: Support role. State 0: thin knobbly vertical strand of crusty rock or root, about a third of a cell wide, dark brown with orange and pale grey nodules (#18180c, #30180c, #3c180c), hanging between floors next to lifts and shafts: cells 13 rows 16-28, 43 rows 20-40, 47 rows 20-40, 52 rows 29-44, 65 rows 20-24, 76 rows 30-38, 82 rows 43-60, 102 rows 29-38, 107 rows 24-36, 113 rows 42-65, 123 rows 31-38, 132 rows 20-29, 137 rows 15-29, 151 rows 43-46. State 1: thick twisted cable 2 cells wide of overlapping rounded grey-green strands (#303024, #3c3018, #182418), cells 62-63 rows 52-58 on floor 59. Sized h.

refs.caption: map M41: strands beside the shale pillar
map M41: twisted cable at cols 62-63

objects.name: Cave rock walls
objects.description: Filler role (terrain wall and deep art). Shale rock: stacked horizontal flakes of rust brown (#30180c, #483018) with orange highlights and dark gaps on the near-black cave brown (#13100c), the original wall tiles (9,61)-(9,64) and (9,66)-(9,69). The free-standing shale pillars 2-4 cells wide are the same rock: cells 15-19 rows 20-25, 33-36 rows 7-15, 104-107 rows 24-36, 75-78 rows 40-48, 79-82 rows 51-61, 86-89 rows 55-58, 109-112 rows 55-58, 116-119 rows 44-47, 136-139 rows 17-20. Sized w and h in cells.

refs.caption: map M41: shale pillar at cols 104-107
map M41: shale pillar at the west end of floor 20

objects.name: Rock floor plank
objects.description: Floor role (terrain ledge). Thin pebbled floor strip about a third of a cell thick: rounded olive-grey and brown pebbles (#303024, #30240c, #3c3018) with a lighter top edge and a ragged dark underside. Every floor row has it (for example 19-39 row 20, 27-36 row 36, 131-150 row 48, the bottom corridor row 74 and the lower strip row 76). State 1 is the end cap of a run (tiles (7,22) (7,23) (7,103) (7,104)): the strip ends in a rounded broken stone. Sized w.

refs.caption: map M41: floor 20
map M41: floor 48 to its east end

objects.name: Metal machinery pillars
objects.description: Building role. Riveted machine-room front, 4-5 rows tall, standing on a floor: dark green-grey steel (#303c24, #3c3c30, #243024) in square bays with bevelled diagonal panels, vertical I-beam posts with round rivets, a horizontal rail with thin pipes along the top. State 1 adds a curved hull section (an arched green-grey plate with a rivet row); state 2 a broken bay with a bent riveted strut hanging askew. Cells 108-122 rows 10-14 and 100-103 rows 10-14 (floor 15), 110-121 rows 16-20 (floor 21), 49-53 rows 15-19 (floor 20), 65-71 rows 32-36 (floor 37), 28-36 rows 39-42 (floor 43, EXPLOSIVE plate), 41-50 rows 50-54 (floor 55, around the lift lock), 16-24 rows 58-62 (floor 63, broken strut), 69-73 rows 60-63 (floor 64), 58-62 rows 70-73 (floor 74). Sized w and h in cells.

refs.caption: map M41: machine-room fronts on floors 15 and 21
map M41: broken strut at the west end of floor 63
map M41: front with the EXPLOSIVE plate on floor 43

objects.name: Glowing lava curtain and strip
objects.description: Wall role. Lava curtain at cells 37-42 rows 68-73 over the bottom corridor floor 74 (sheet 1 tile 3): six stacked one-row bands of dark red (#78240c, #542400, #6c300c) with fine vertical orange and yellow streaks and a dark seam between bands. Ours: a lava cascade in a cleft of the back wall, its pool hidden behind a lit rock sill; animated flow; sized w and h. The lava strips in the corridor floor are the lavaPit hazard. Effect on the hero not traced.

refs.caption: map M41: lava curtain over the bottom corridor

objects.name: Parallax cave backdrop
objects.description: Sky role. Full-screen backdrop (LEV4.GRA frame 0): the top two thirds a mossy rock ceiling in olive and brown (#484830, #483c24, #303024) with darker cracks, then a near-black band, then pale grey-brown ground (#6c603c, #484830) with eleven conical stalagmites of light tan (#846c54, #a87854) casting short dark shadows, and at the bottom a glowing lava stripe of orange and yellow flecks (#e48418, #f0b430, #e46018).

refs.caption: background frame 0

objects.name: Cart crusher
objects.description: Toothed crushing rollers in a steel frame at the east end of the mine cart conveyor, the cart crush death zone (columns 123-125, report 16 zones), with sparks.

objects.name: Far dripstone cave
objects.description: Far role. Flat dark silhouettes of a far cave hall: rows of stalagmites rising from a ground line and stalactites hanging from a ceiling line, in the brown and olive of the backdrop under haze, sized w and h; state 1 adds a dripstone curtain and a pale far lava glow at the bottom. Fills the open void between floors, which is plain near-black brown (#13100c) in the original.

refs.caption: background frame 0

objects.name: Curved rock rib band
objects.description: Wall role. Band 3-5 rows tall above a floor of big curved rock ribs bowing right like a row of crescents, rust brown and orange (#30180c, #483018, #6c3c18) with grey-green highlights on their edges, and a row of grey-brown diagonal scree slabs along the foot. State 1 has a dark hollow: a black oval opening the ribs frame. Cells 47-56 rows 16-19 (floor 20), 20-35 rows 23-27 (floor 28), 27-38 rows 30-35 (floor 36, hollow at 27-31), 54-79 rows 25-28 (floor 29, hollow at 59-71), 85-104 rows 25-28 (floor 29), 96-110 rows 10-14 (floor 15), 101-108 rows 16-20 (floor 21), 58-75 rows 32-36 (floor 37), 116-127 rows 27-31 (floor 32), 91-102 rows 47-51 (floor 52), 97-108 rows 53-57 (floor 58), 123-148 rows 43-47 (floor 48), 37-56 rows 50-54 (floor 55), 19-50 rows 58-62 (floor 63, hollow at 47-52), 64-75 rows 59-63 (floor 64), 16-35 rows 66-73 and 45-120 rows 69-73 (floor 74, hollows at 19-24 and 117-123). Sized w and h in cells.

refs.caption: map M41: rib band and dark hollow on floor 36
map M41: rib band on floor 32

objects.name: Steel pressure cylinder
objects.description: Machine role. Upright brushed steel cylinder 2 cells wide and 4 rows tall (#546060, #3c4848, #485454) with a dark shaded right side, a cap ring of olive and dark checker squares (#786c3c, #545448) with a bright white lamp glare on its front, and a slim curved blue-grey strap one cell to its right. It stands in the rib bands: cells 20-21 rows 23-27 (strap 22, floor 28), 96-97 rows 11-14 (strap 98, floor 15), 57-58 and 61-62 rows 40-43 (floor 44), 70-71 and 86-87 rows 70-73 (floor 74). Sized h.

refs.caption: map M41: cylinder on floor 28
map M41: cylinder on floor 15

objects.name: Cave work lamp
objects.description: Mounted and sign role. Bright white lamp glare (#fcfcfc) with a long thin horizontal lens streak, lighting a curved green-grey glass dome behind it (#485430, #3c4830), set into the rib bands about 2 rows above the floor. Cells 24 and 26 rows 24-26 (floor 28), 91, 94, 96 and 98 rows 25-27 (floor 29), 64-68 rows 40-43 (floor 44), 77-80 rows 70-72 (floor 74). State 1 is dead: dark glass, no glare.

refs.caption: map M41: four lamps on floor 29

objects.name: EXPLOSIVE plate
objects.description: Sign role. Grey steel plate about 3 cells wide and half a row tall with the stencil EXPLOSIVE in olive letters (#545448 on #3c483c), mounted on the machine-room front at cells 28-30 row 39 (floor 43), over a small grey box. State 1 is a red hazard plate with the same stencil.

refs.caption: map M41: EXPLOSIVE plate on floor 43

objects.name: Mine pipe run
objects.description: Pipe role. Thin dark green-grey pipes with flange rings and a rivet clamp, like the pipes along the top rail of the machine-room fronts (cells 30-35 row 39) and the curved strap beside each pressure cylinder; state 0 a horizontal run, state 1 a vertical riser with an elbow at the top. Sized w or h.

refs.caption: map M41: pipes on the front on floor 43

objects.name: Scree heap
objects.description: Rubble role. Heap of angular grey-brown rock slabs leaning on each other (#30180c, #483018, #30240c with pale grey edges), like the scree at the foot of every rib band (for example cells 27-34 rows 34-35); state 1 a heap of broken shale flakes with pale crystal chips. Sized w.

refs.caption: map M41: scree at the foot of the rib band on floor 36

objects.name: Mine safety railing
objects.description: Fence role. Rusted steel posts every 2 cells with two sagging chain rails and a red and white tag, for chasm and lava edges; state 1 broken: one post bent down and the chain hanging loose. Sized w.

objects.name: Mine wreck
objects.description: Big clutter. State 0: an olive ore cart like the conveyor carts tipped on its side off its rails, wheels up, spilling ore lumps (about 3 cells wide); state 1: an abandoned rock drill on caterpillar tracks with a long rusted drill boom and a broken lamp (about 5 cells wide).

objects.name: Powder kegs
objects.description: Small clutter. Wooden kegs with iron hoops and a stencilled red mark, matching the EXPLOSIVE store; state 0 a single keg, state 1 a stack of three, state 2 a burst keg with scorched staves.

objects.name: Miner's crate
objects.description: Small clutter. Wooden crate with iron corners; state 0 open with a pickaxe and a shovel leaning on it, state 1 full of olive ore lumps, state 2 a smashed crate.
